recipes.name: Quick and Easy Sicilian Meatloaf
ingredients_raw: 1 (1 ounce) package dry onion soup mix
8 thin slices deli ham, or as needed
1 cup shredded Swiss cheese, or as needed

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Place a 24-inch sheet of parchment paper onto a work surface.

Mix ground beef, bread crumbs, onion soup mix, barbecue sauce, garlic, egg, flour, and black pepper together in a bowl until well combined. Transfer meat mixture to the parchment paper, and pat it into a 10x16-inch rectangle shape. Layer ham slices on the meat, keeping 1 inch uncovered around all sides of the rectangle. Sprinkle Swiss cheese over ham.

Carefully lift up a short edge of the meat rectangle with the parchment paper, and gently nudge and roll meat up and over the filling. Seal the edges and ends well. Transfer meatloaf to a 9x13-inch baking dish; discard the parchment paper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.

Meanwhile, mix ketchup, mustard, brown sugar, and soy sauce together in a bowl until sugar dissolves. Remove meatloaf from the oven and spread ketchup mixture over top. Return to the oven and bake until beef is no longer pink in the center, about 15 more minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).

raw_recipe.headline: Quick and Easy Sicilian Meatloaf
raw_recipe.description: This savory Sicilian meatloaf is an eye-catching dish! Unlike regular meatloaf, the ground beef mixture is rolled around slices of ham and Swiss cheese.

review.reviewBody: Made this tohight- great recipe! Too good to be called meatloaf. I didn't have any thin deli ham, but used leftover baked ham sliced thin and was delicious. Thank you for sharing this recipe!

I put the meatloaf mixture on the parchment paper, placed another piece on top of it, pressed down, and then used a rolling pin to shape it into a 10x16-inch rectangle. It then was very easy to roll up jelly-roll style. Be sure to seal the ends well to keep the cheese from oozing out, and place the meat seam side down on the baking pan. I waited for about 5 minutes after it came out of the oven to slice, but the slices did fall apart a bit. Leftovers sliced beautifully with the ham circling inside each slice, so next time I’ll wait 15-20 minutes hoping for nicer plating. The flavor is warm and comforting, and the ham-cheese combo really styles up ordinary meatloaf. I can see many variations on the ham and swiss, but unlike many of the reviewers, I was satisfied with the recipe as written. The only change I’ll make is just using tangy Heinz Chili Sauce (my go-to topping on meatloaf) instead of the topping sauce mixture in the recipe. This meatloaf didn’t photograph well for me, but it’s an interesting spin on meatloaf, is very tasty, and I was happy with the way it turned out.

I made some changes and it came out really delicious. I used hot capicolla, mozzarella cheese and fresh basil leaves for the filling. Gave it a really nice flavor. After baking, topped with marinara sauce.

Amazing!!! My husband and I have been married for seven years and he had yet to like any meatloaf I've tried to make.. until now. Recipe is easy to make and tastes like you have spent hours on it. I didn't have any swiss so I replaced it with Parmesan which worked great and made it a little more true as a Sicilian dish. I was worried about it being too sweet like some of the reviews said, so I carefully brushed the sauce on as a light glaze which my husband said it was the perfect amount of sauce. He told me this is a must have and a new staple. Yay, I finally have a go to meatloaf recipe! Thank you for sharing!

We made this recipe for 100 people at our local soup kitchen. We used a 1/2 cup scoop and baked them for 25 mins. We added the sauce to the meat mixture (because someone didn’t read the recipe) and it was delicious. We received many compliments from the clients.

This meatloaf was a huge hit! Following some of the suggestions, and lacking swiss cheese, I topped the "meat square" with about 1/3 cup of marinara sauce, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese, then rolled it up. After baking 45 minutes, I spread marinara sauce on top and finished baking. It was great :) I made oven-roasted red skinned potatoes with it, and they came out of the oven at about the same time. Perfect combination for an easy and delicious dinner!

Tried the recipe as written and found it to be quite good. With a few changes, however, my family enjoyed it even more. Substituted 6 slices of crumbled bacon for the ham and 4 cheese Italian mix for the Swiss. Added an extra clove of garlic and 1-2 tsps of Italian Seasoning. Also chopped some fresh onion in place of the onion soup. This recipe's been a big hit for me and thanks for posting it.

I love the meatloaf.I make mine with hard boiled eggs parmesian cheese in the middle. don't even have to roll it. Put half of the meat down,put eggs and sprinkle with cheese put the rest of the meat on top.

This is really good however I'm not sure of the name, definitely not sicilian. I will make again substituting with prosciutto, provolone, roasted red peppers, and spinach inside and homemade marinara on the top. Great recipe and can be made with many variations.
Holy cow this was delicious! I split the 1 1/2 lbs of meat into part beef and part Italian sausage. .. other than that I followed the recipe exactly. Can't wait to make it again!

This is phenomenal ! I put everything all together mixed it and baked...was delish. Making it again today and will follow instructions tjis time and put catsup mixture over the top as written. We'll see if we lile it just as much ! Cooked ours out on the grill on low for 35 min.
Single Dad who makes this at least once a month. Recipe as is or play a little with some Jalapenos, it's just great.
The only thing that happened is the ham all ended up on one end of the meatloaf. But still it was very good. I would not change or add anything it is great on its own.
Very, very bland. Will not make it again

The only change I made to this excellent recipe is I used sliced Swiss cheese instead of grated. I’ve made this meatloaf three times now and will be using it as my go to meatloaf. 
I slice it when it is cool and freeze two slices together for a quick dinner for my husband and me. All it needs is one minute in the microwave to heat it up. A winner.
Easy to make. I followed the recipe exactly. I had a lot of deli ham left over from when we had people out and looked for a way to use it up. I would make this again.
delicious, quick and easy.every bit got gobbled up immediately.
Soooooo delicious
This was great!! If you live near a Wegmans but
So gooooooood
